description.value: Made in India is an Indian cuisine fast-food outlet occupying a food court stall inside Orchard Mall in Kelowna, one of five Lower Mainland and Okanagan locations in the chain. The menu centres on authentic Indian dishes available for dine-in or pickup. Its mall food-court setting puts it within easy reach of the KLO Road cycling corridor on the south side of Kelowna.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the 'MADE IN INDIA FOOD COURT' location at 2271 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna — a food court outlet within Orchard Mall. The phone number (236) 420-1684 and address on the website match OSM exactly. Takeout/pickup is confirmed by the website's repeated 'Pickup' ordering option for this location; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM name is 'Made in India' but the website identifies this specific location as 'MADE IN INDIA FOOD COURT' — minor name discrepancy worth noting for directory display.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating food court location confirmed by the brand's own website with matching address and phone; useful stop for touring cyclists passing through the Harvey Ave corridor.

wow_evidence: food court stall inside Orchard Mall in Kelowna, one of five Lower Mainland and Okanagan locations
